messages:
Alex: I'm taking the overnight shift but heads-up — I'll be offline 02:15->03:30 UTC for a brief call. Need to confirm secondary coverage and who will own the bridge if anything pops up in that window. Current rotation shows Maria as secondary until 03:00 UTC, @Maria can you confirm?

incident-bot: ALERT: KV-store read latency > 400ms in us-west (P2). Assigned: Alex. Start: 1782101300. Auto-triage: increased miss rate on hot prefix. Suggested runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.com/kv-lag

Maria: I can take primary from 02:20 until 04:00, but I need a quick warm-handoff summary and current mitigation state. I'll be on the bridge at 02:18.

Alex: Short summary:
- Symptom: read latency spikes + elevated 5xx for cached keys
- Root cause (suspected): autoscaler failed to provision + recent config tweak increased cache churn
- What we've done: rolled back config PR #1125, enabled prefix caching for hot keys, paused noncritical batch jobs
- Bridge: #incident-468 (https://meet.redwood.com/incident-468)
- Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.com/kv-lag
- Ticket: INC-468 (notes updated)

Jon: If autoscaler can't add nodes, plan B is to route critical reads to the dedicated eu-west read pool (read-only fallback). I'll stand by to run the traffic-shift. Whoever is primary during 02:15-03:30 should confirm before I trigger the switch.

Sam: Paging rules reminder from playbook: P1 => immediate page to oncall-platform + oncall-leads; P2 => page primary and oncall-sre if unresolved > 10m. We're P2 right now. Recommend escalation to oncall-sre at 20m if latency doesn't improve.

Alex: A couple of asks: Maria, please confirm you accept primary for 02:20-03:30 and own the PD escalation timeouts. If you can't, Sam please take primary.

Maria: I accept. I'll be primary 02:20-03:30. I'll open the PD escalation to 15m and join the bridge at 02:18. Will add a short summary in INC-468 before you go offline.

Alex: Added notes to INC-468: "KV misses, autoscaler quota error, rolled back config, prefix cache enabled." Also pinned diagnostics snippet below.

Alex: ```
# quick checks
incidentctl status kv-metrics --window=15m
kubectl -n inference describe hpa kv-autoscaler
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=kv-cache
# PD escalation (run if >15m unresolved)
/pd escalate --incident INC-468 --policy "sev2-standard" --timeout 15m
```

Leah: Paging escalation hierarchy (condensed): primary -> secondary -> oncall-sre -> eng-leads -> exec-oncall. For mobile escalation use the phone-tree if PD doesn't reach responders within timeout.

Jon: If we do the eu-west traffic shift, add header: `X-Fallback-Region: eu-west` and monitor 50x and 5xx rate closely for the first 5 minutes. Rollback immediately on regressions.

incident-bot: NOTE: Customer-impact rule: if >3 customers affected or error rate >0.5% escalate to P1 and page oncall-leads automatically.

Sam: Also reminder: if PD escalation fails to get an ack within 10m, use the PD mobile page + call the oncall lead (numbers in wiki). Don't rely on slack pings only for urgent pages.

Maria: Accepted primary. On the bridge now; I'll toggle read-only fallback for hot keys in 02:25 if latency stays high, then ask Jon to shift traffic to eu-west if that doesn't help.

Alex: Thanks all. Quick post-handoff checklist I'm leaving for Maria:
- Confirm PD escalation timeout set to 15m
- Update INC-468 with any mitigation commands and customer-impact estimate
- If switching traffic, add the fallback header and monitor 5min windows
- If autoscaler quota is the blocker, open cloud quota ticket with infra@ and tag emergency=true

Leah: Extra note on cloud quota: when opening the ticket include `quota-id`, exact error logs (`kubectl describe hpa`), and the region. Mark it as emergency for priority handling.

Maria: Got it. Bridge link again: https://meet.redwood.com/incident-468. I'll post a short update in 10m and escalate to oncall-sre at 02:40 if no improvement. Thanks Alex, leaving you with the ticket and runbook links pinned.

Sam: Thanks. If anything escalates to P1 during your offline window, primary (Maria) should page oncall-platform immediately and follow the P1 checklist in the runbook.

Alex: Back to you, Maria. I'll be reachable by phone if needed. Good luck and ping me if you need me to rejoin the bridge.
